about_the_game:
Horror platformer.

The player must stop the Grey Cloak, a kidnapper of children, by immersing himself in the world of horror in the imagination of a boy Leo - the victim of the kidnapper.

The detective is engaged in the search for a maniac who kidnaps children. Of all the clues only the description of the maniac's bus. Meanwhile, another - 12 victim, an orphan boy named Leo disappears. Again, no clues, but everything is solved by an anonymous call. Someone saw a similar bus near an abandoned building.

The police enter this building, the maniac manages to escape, but Leo is saved – the Detective carried him in his arms. Unfortunately, the boy fell into a catatonic stupor – he plunged into his inner world, completely detached from reality.

The famous Dr. Valentine offers help. According to the Doctor, the Brain Machine invented by him is able to bring the boy out of the stupor, which in turn will help in catching the maniac, after all the boy saw him.

To find the criminal, you must:

- Fight Leo's inner monsters.

- Move across platforms.

- Avoid traps.

- Solve logical tasks.

- Look for clues in the environment.

Features of the game:

- Artistic plot.

- Original graphics.

- The genre of platformer, combined with the quest detective part.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 @ 2.2GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+ @ 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 240 GT or Radeon HD 6570 – 1024 MB (1 gig)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10,11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2300 or AMD FX6120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 550 Ti or Radeon HD 6770
  • DirectX: Version 11
